result_json.guidance: Approval drift policy: anchor approved plan bytes to the source plan-review run’s finalized plan commit (including its workflow Status update), validating recorded terminal approval and final-correction evidence; later edits remain drift. Move Phase 0 verification prose out of the plan into run records, retain checklist completion. Fix the worktree canonical identity/current-byte/approved-byte P0 bug and all mechanical P2 issues identified in the phase-1 review. Add end-to-end tests for the real source-finalization and worktree paths. Do not infer approval from arbitrary later HEAD.

A waiver without measured post-state evidence receives zero realized credit. Waiver adjusts the governing approved obligation/credit envelope and preserves original claim/evidence history; it cannot mint realizedN/D or manufacture an assessment. Fix all auto_fix findings in the Phase 7 review, including past-phase settled-claim carry-forward and composition tests.
